network_status.network: Picinisco, i danni della piena del Mollarino e il ponte crollato nel 2020
network_status.summary_it: La fonte corretta documenta la piena del Mollarino e il crollo del ponte in localita Serre a Picinisco il 15 ottobre 2020, ma non pubblica livello, portata o stazione. Le precedenti fonti piemontesi erano estranee al caso laziale e vengono escluse dal dossier.
network_status.summary_en: The corrected source documents the Mollarino flood and collapse of the bridge at Serre, Picinisco, on 15 October 2020 but publishes no stage, discharge or station. Earlier Piedmont sources were unrelated to the Lazio case and are excluded from the dossier.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
